Multiplayer facts

Big Walk Crossplay and Player Count

Big Walk is an online cooperative multiplayer game. Nintendo's official product page lists 2 to 12 players, crossplay, and no single-player mode; the publisher confirms a minimum of 2 and up to 12 players.

Multiplayer Details

ModeOnline cooperative multiplayer only; no single-player mode
Player count2 to 12 players; flexible group size
CrossplayYes, play online with friends on other platforms
CommunicationProximity voice chat, walkie-talkies, gestures, and tools
PlatformsNintendo Switch 2, Steam (PC and Mac), PlayStation 5

Nintendo describes Big Walk as a multiplayer game without a single-player mode, entirely about teamwork and talking. Game8's review adds that the game supports groups of two to twelve players and emphasizes communication through proximity voice chat, gestures, and interactive tools.

How Puzzles Scale with Group Size

Screen Hype reports that Big Walk only scales for 2, 3, and 4 players. Higher player counts add extra objective targets, such as more switches to press or higher point requirements, but the solution steps and puzzle logic stay the same.

Teamwork tip: because the game has no matchmaking-style solo path, coordinate your group before starting. A focused two-player team and a larger group both work, but the communication demands grow with every extra player.
